 Display: 15.6" diagonal, FHD (1920 x 1080), Anti-glare

 Audio: Dual speakers
 Keyboard: Full Size Keyboard, with Numeric Keypad, US English
 Built-in HD Webcam: HD 720p
 Ports:
 1 x USB Type-C 10Gbps signaling rate
 2 x USB Type-A 5Gbps signaling rate
 1 x Ethernet (RJ-45)
 1 x HDMI
 1 x Multi-format Media Card Reader
 1 x Headphone / Microphone Combo Jack
 1 x AC smart pin
 Color: Black
 Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 14.1 x 9.5 x 0.78
 Weight: 3.84 lbs

items.label: Powerful & Efficient
items.value: With the power of the Intel i3-1315U, you can tackle your workload with ease and speed without worrying about browser tabs freezing your system.

items.label: Crystal Clear Screen
items.value: See the beauty of the world from the comfort of your laptop through the Full HD 1920 x 1080 screen that even comes with Anti-Glare coating to make sure nothing gets between you and your screen.

items.label: Versatility within Your Hands
items.value: With the plethora of ports that comes with the 250 G9, never worry about not having the right cable or cables to connect to your laptop.

items.label: All-Day Battery
items.value: Up to 10 hours of battery life keeps you productive without constantly reaching for a charger.

items.label: High Quality Camera
items.value: With the help of Temporal Noise Reduction, show your camera off without any fear of blemishes.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad, Spill Resistant

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, keyboards, mice, storage devices, printers, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices
